_about: How the Play page's game behaves. Edit this file (play/spec.json); the publisher copies it to docs/playvs/spec.json and the page reads it at start. The page shows it under Settings → Game spec. A viewer's own switches (Settings) override the 'toggles' defaults on their device.

about.advisor: The network (a file in docs/playvs/models/) that estimates your win probability and suggests moves. It never plays. If the file is missing, the strongest listed opponent is used.
about.toggles.win_probability: Default for the win-probability bar: the advisor's chance that you win, from your seat, at each of your decisions, with a small graph of the game so far.
about.toggles.suggestion: Default for suggestions: the advisor's favourite answers to your current decision, with its probabilities. Off by default, so a first game is your own.
about.toggles.opponent_thinking: Default for showing what the opponent network considered on its last decision.
about.suggestion.show_top: How many answers the suggestion lists (best first).
about.suggestion.mark_on_board: Also put a star on the suggested card in the supply or your hand.
about.start.opponent: Which opponent is selected at first: the position in docs/playvs/models.json (0 = the strongest).
about.start.seat: Which seat you take at first: first, second or random.
about.start.kingdom: random, or a list of 10 kingdom card names to always play that kingdom.
about.turn.confirm_end_turn_from_coins: Ask before ending a buy phase with at least this many coins unspent (0 = never ask).
about.turn.show_their_turn: Show a summary of the opponent's last turn at the top of the board.
about.take_back.enabled: Allow taking back your last move (the game is replayed from the start; the opponent is deterministic).
about.review.enabled: After the game, list the moves where the advisor would have chosen differently.
about.review.min_gap: Only list a move when the advisor's favourite was at least this much more likely than your choice (0.25 = 25 points).
about.review.show: At most this many moves in the review (largest gaps first).
about.log_lines: How many lines the game log keeps on screen.
